description: This file defines the VoiceWakeManager class, a component responsible for handling voice wake-up commands using Android's SpeechRecognizer API. It manages starting/stopping listening, processing transcriptions, and triggering commands when wake words are detected.

classes.name: VoiceWakeManager
classes.description: Manages voice wake-up commands, handling speech recognition sessions, processing transcriptions, and interacting with the app's coroutine scope.

methods.name: setTriggerWords
methods.description: Sets the list of words that trigger voice commands.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the speech recognition listening process.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the speech recognition process and updates status text.

methods.name: startListeningInternal
methods.description: Configures and begins speech recognition listening with specified intent parameters.

methods.name: scheduleRestart
methods.description: Schedules a restart of the speech recognizer after a delay, handling errors and reinitialization.

methods.name: handleTranscription
methods.description: Processes recognized speech; if it contains trigger words, invokes the command callback.
